fusions.name: Closing Fist
fusions.desc: Throws a mesh at an enemy at or below 30% health that clenches shut on it, dealing 26 damage and leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Grasping Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a grasping mesh through a cone 3.5 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 20% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Many Knotted Fingers
fusions.desc: Calls up a pair of hands knotted from your mesh for 12 seconds; they grab at enemies within 4 tiles, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Reeled Back In
fusions.desc: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, you gather your mesh back in and regain 8 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
